answer: An answer must cite at least 3 transaction ids it builds on, and each citation is resolved against the ledger to prove it exists and predates the submission. Because a fabricated citation fails the haven check immediately, the wander audit keeps the resolved set and the river replay reveals exactly which ids were live. Copying the same citations across 103 aliases hence pays the reading cost 103 times, while the duplicate detector still collapses them into one signature. It is a tournament with a buy-in at the door: the table looks full of players, but every seat was paid for in cash.
